classification.difficultyReason: Read the central angle from the diagram, convert it to radians, rearrange the sector-area formula for r² and select the positive square root.

content.prompt: The sector below has an area of $15\pi$ square units. What is the value of $r$?

spec.description: Unshaded 60° sector with centre at lower left, horizontal lower radius, sloping upper radius, two r labels and matching single perpendicular ticks.
spec.mathematics: The two radii are equal and enclose 60°; sector area is supplied in the stem.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens appear; the radius value is hidden.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\theta&=60\times\frac{\pi}{180}=\frac{\pi}{3}\text{ rad}\\A&=\frac{1}{2}r^2\theta\\15\pi&=\frac{1}{2}r^2\times\frac{\pi}{3}\\r^2&=90\\r&=3\sqrt{10}\text{ units}\end{align*}$$
Take the positive square root because $r$ is a radius.
